statement: ISO/TS 15066:2016 的协作应用要求（SRMS/手引导/SSM/PFL 与生物力学接触限值）已并入 ISO 10218-1/-2:2025；ISO/AWI 15066-1 在研并将取代 TS 15066:2016
supports_statement: ISO 10218-2:2025 吸收 TS 15066 协作条款；iso.org 显示 ISO/AWI 15066-1 stage 20.00、'Will replace ISO/TS 15066:2016'
note: p20/p22 同步记载；OJ 列名经二手来源

statement: 在 Blackwell 信息结构序下，投票与辩论诱导的信息结构不优于全体智能体私有信息的池化；MA-PoP 在六个 QA 基准超过辩论/投票
supports_statement: voting and debate induce information structures that are no more informative than the pooled private information; MA-PoP outperforms debate and voting on six QA benchmarks
note: 摘要层面；池化后验的条件独立假设未评估

statement: PRIMEX-PEV 用素指数向量表示信息谱系，在指数空间以 GCD/LCM 消除冗余并保留谱系，支持异步更新与部分信息传播
supports_statement: prime exponent vector representations; GCD/LCM operations in exponent space remove redundancy and preserve information lineage
note: 摘要层面；BF 适配性未评估

statement: OWASP Agentic Top 10 2026 将记忆与上下文投毒列为 ASI06；Microsoft 2026-02 六十天研究在多个生产助手中观测到记忆投毒尝试
supports_statement: ASI06 Memory and Context Poisoning; Microsoft observed memory poisoning attempts in production traffic across major assistants
note: 二手来源；具体攻击面数据未核

statement: 一项 2026 年四模型研究显示 LLM 生成的 HAZOP 工作表场景仅 19-37% 技术有效，且多为程序性屏障
supports_statement: only 19-37% of scenarios were truly valid; many safeguards suggested were procedural rather than engineering-based
note: 行业媒体转述；须定位原文

statement: mTSBench 覆盖 19 数据集 344 序列 24 检测器，无通用冠军，最好的无监督选择器仅捕获 oracle 性能的 72%
supports_statement: no single detector excels across datasets; best unsupervised selector captured 72% of oracle performance
note: 摘要层面

statement: SCoRE 以广义 e 值与假设检验为任意有界连续风险提供有限样本信任决策，无需均匀集中且可扩展至分布漂移
supports_statement: Selective Conformal Risk control with E-values; finite-sample error control without uniform concentration; extends to distribution shifts
note: 摘要层面

statement: 联合有限样本证书可同时上界被选风险、下界接受概率与部署效用；接受概率下界依赖从 1/p_min 改进到 1/sqrt(p_min)
supports_statement: single finite-sample certificate simultaneously upper-bounds selected risk, lower-bounds acceptance probability and deployment utility; sharpens acceptance-floor dependence from 1/p_min to 1/sqrt(p_min)
note: 摘要层面；regime-scoped 增益非普遍

statement: 事件级增强基准上，SWaT 对数漂移条件下把归一化流换成高斯密度使高压 F1 从约 0.75 降至约 0.57
supports_statement: on SWaT under log drift, replacing normalizing flows with Gaussian density reduces high-stress F1 from ~0.75 to ~0.57
note: 摘要层面

statement: 工业数字主线语义图统一：阻断 24 个跨系统工具使 recall 从 1.00 降到 0.31，约 69% 可发现信号需要跨系统图连接
supports_statement: blocking 24 cross-system tools reduces recall from 1.00 to 0.31; 69% of discoverable signals require cross-system graph joins
note: 摘要层面；模拟数据

statement: IEECR 把量子概率的干涉效应引入 D-S 框架：构造焦点元素关联图量化命题间干涉强度并把多元素焦元质量再分配至单点，配模糊隶属度 BPA 生成与 Deng 熵证据排序；四个数据集上优于五个代表性融合方法（26.33% 重叠 91.00%、29.02% 重叠 85.00% 准确率）
supports_statement: quantum probability theory introduced into Dempster-Shafer framework; interference effect-driven evidence combination rule (IEECR); focal element association graph quantifies interference intensities; fuzzy membership-based BPA generation and Deng-entropy-based evidence ordering; consistently outperforms five representative fusion methods (91.00% / 85.00% accuracy)
note: SSRN 预印本；比较协议未核。

statement: gamma-CUBV 以单一指数框架统一风险界族（Hoeffding/Bernstein/依赖感知/PAC-Bayes/异质源融合）；K 折 CV 折间等相关下有效折数 K_eff=K/[1+(K−1)ρ]，强依赖时增大 K 不必然增加统计证据；多源加权融合权重按「未来风险上界最小化」选择而非经验误差
supports_statement: single exponential framework with cumulant envelope gamma(lambda); risk bounds covering Hoeffding-, Bernstein-, dependency-aware, PAC-Bayesian, and heterogeneous source-fusion settings; effective number of folds Keff = K/[1+(K-1)rho]; weights selected by minimising an upper bound on future risk
does_not_support: empirical superiority beyond linear-classifier Gaussian-mixture experiments
note: 与 G3 的 N_eff 同构；分析侧依赖折扣工具。

statement: C-EDL 以任务保持变换生成多样视图、量化表示分歧，对 EDL 预测做冲突感知后处理校准（免重训、低开销）；多数据集/攻击/度量下把 OOD 覆盖降低至约 55%、对抗覆盖降低至约 90%；v3 为 ICLR 2026 正式版
supports_statement: Conflict-aware Evidential Deep Learning (C-EDL) is a lightweight post-hoc UQ approach; generates diverse task-preserving transformations and quantifies representational disagreement; coverage reductions for OOD data (up to ~55%) and adversarial data (up to ~90%); v3 updated to the published ICLR 2026 version

statement: CLEAR 用校准数据刻画潜空间的组条件几何，推理时生成潜空间扰动视图并度量其与校准几何的冲突，冲突高则选择性压低证据强度；ImageNet→CUB 上 OOD/对抗 AUROC +8.29/+5.01，比竞争者快 17.4×，跨分类/回归/检测保持预测性能
supports_statement: CLEAR: lightweight task-agnostic post-hoc method; measures conflict of latent perturbation views relative to calibrated geometry; improves OOD and adversarial AUROC by +8.29 and +5.01 while running 17.4× faster than competing post-hoc methods
note: 与 C-EDL 同族（冲突→校准）。

statement: EESD 把「执行相关性支撑」与「证据质量（有效伪计数）」分离：归一化相关性定相对支持与伪计数质量，Dirichlet 后验产生不确定性惩罚权重；观测 1→8 使未来 NLL 降 55.0–59.3%，一轮修正学习后 DeepSeek/CodeARC Pass@1 15.0%→20.4%（配对 95% bootstrap [+2.8,+8.0]pp）
supports_statement: representing evidence support and evidence mass separately; effective pseudo-count mass; a Dirichlet posterior produces an uncertainty-penalized weight; NLL reduced by 55.0-59.3%; Pass@1 increases from 15.0% to 20.4%, paired 95% source-bootstrap interval [+2.8, +8.0]
note: 「支持-质量分离」与项目贡献守恒/质量元层同向。

statement: BELIEFRAG 为自适应 RAG 维护显式证据状态（充分性/可靠性/冲突/不确定性/缺口/获取成本），闭环选择检索/改写/验证/回答/停止/拒答；六 QA 基准（gpt-oss-120b）F1 0.572 vs 固定迭代 0.555 且 token 少 39%，Qwen3-32B 同型；「校准的可回答性」操作性最强，但来源漂移仍可使同一决策信号失效
supports_statement: closed-loop controller over an explicit evidence state (sufficiency, reliability, conflict, uncertainty, evidence gaps, acquisition cost) choosing among retrieval/rewriting/verification/answering/stopping/abstention; F1 0.572 with 39% fewer tokens; calibrated answerability strongest; source shift can still invalidate the same decision signal
note: LLM 证据治理最邻近工作；须引用定位。

statement: SLLCP 是覆盖冻结 VLM 的 split 标签局部化 conformal 校准层，输出概率校准的安全预测集（可交换下标签条件有限样本覆盖）；15k CARLA 未见场景上识别 89.6%（Qwen）/88.4%（Cosmos）肇事轨迹，基线 VLM 仅 4.6%/39.1%
supports_statement: Split Label-Localized Conformal Prediction (SLLCP), a post-hoc calibration layer over frozen VLMs; label-conditional finite-sample distribution-free coverage under exchangeability; flags 89.6% / 88.4% of collision-causing trajectories vs 4.6% / 39.1% base
note: VLM 安全监控全链路示例。

statement: paraphrase-aware conformal：语义等价改写会使 LLM 置信度失稳（连 conformal 亦然）；以 LLM 隐状态训练轻量代理、跨改写聚合构造标签级非一致性分数，分数可交换下保持边际覆盖；七个多选 QA 基准（含仅测试集改写）覆盖近标称
supports_statement: trains a lightweight proxy model on LLM hidden states and aggregates across paraphrases to construct label-wise nonconformity scores; conformal calibration retains marginal coverage; coverage generally near nominal even in the semi-reworded setting
note: 改写鲁棒性=版本/表述漂移近亲。

statement: 系统级视域：LLM 应用是复合系统，不确定性跨模型内部/工作流阶段/组件边界/持久状态/人-组织流程被变换复用，早期错误可传播复合且难以检测与治理；给出 P1/P2/P3 传播分类与五个开放挑战
supports_statement: uncertainty is transformed and reused across model internals, workflow stages, component boundaries, persistent state, and human or organisational processes; early errors can propagate and compound, difficult to detect and govern; taxonomy P1/P2/P3 + five open challenges

scope.method_version: as retrieved 2026-10-08 (arXiv v1; WIP under review)

note: 雪球发现；与本文生命周期治理同构。

statement: IJAR 2026：元公平框架下用 DST（DS2S + Yager 函数 + 厚区间）建模医疗风险预测的认知不确定性；31+19 人轻量用户研究中，DST+简单区间自评理解度最高，更复杂表示被认为更难理解但更能表达不确定性
supports_statement: extends DST framework with Yager's rule and thick intervals; BRCA1/2 synthetic scenario vs logistic regression; user study (31 limited / 19 no prior knowledge): DST with simple intervals achieved highest self-rated understanding
